children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 28, 2026) - Honey Badger Silver Inc.

(OTCQB: HBEIF) (FSE: 1QA) (Tradegate: 1QA) ("Honey Badger Silver" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that members of its management team will attend the 2026 New Orleans Investment Conference, taking place October 28-31, 2026 at the Hilton New Orleans Riverside in New Orleans, Louisiana, and the 2026 Precious Metals Summit Zurich, taking place November 9-11, 2026 at the Park Hyatt Zurich in Zurich, Switzerland.
New Orleans Investment Conference

The New Orleans Investment Conference is one of the longest-running investment events in the world. It brings together investors, analysts, newsletter writers and company executives with a strong focus on precious metals and natural resources. Justin Cochrane, Project Financing & M&A, and Andrew Jedemann, Vice President, Exploration, will represent the Company at booth #407.
Precious Metals Summit Zurich

The Precious Metals Summit Zurich is a by-invitation event. It connects institutional investors, sell-side representatives and senior precious metals executives with a select group of issuers through private one-on-one meetings, giving the Company exposure to European capital.
The Company is set to present at the Precious Metals Summit Zurich on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 4:30pm CET in Room 2.
Honey Badger Silver will use both conferences to
meet with existing shareholders, prospective investors and strategic industry participants as the Company continues to advance the fully-permitted PC Silver Mine in the Northwest Territories.
The PC Silver Mine is one of Canada's most advanced, high-grade silver-zinc-lead mine restarts.

"Following a very productive LME Week in London, we are looking forward to sharing Honey Badger Silver's progress with investors in New Orleans and Zurich," said Chad Williams, Executive Chairman and Interim Chief Executive Officer of Honey Badger Silver.
Investors attending either conference who wish to meet with Honey Badger Silver are encouraged to contact the Company at
investors@honeybadgersilver.com
to arrange a meeting.
About Honey Badger Silver
(OTCQB: HBEIF) (FSE: 1QA) (Tradegate: 1QA)

Honey Badger Silver is a North American silver and critical minerals company. The Company's flagship is the fully permitted, high-grade PC Silver Mine (Prairie Creek) in the Northwest Territories. Honey Badger Silver also holds a portfolio of silver and critical minerals projects across the Northwest Territories, Yukon and Nunavut, including the Sunrise Lake, Plata, Yava and Nanisivik properties, providing district-scale exposure in metal-rich Canadian jurisdictions.

What sets Honey Badger Silver apart is its strategic blend of real silver ownership and growth leverage: the Company holds over 10,000 ounces of physical silver yielding 12% annually, reinforcing tangible asset value while advancing exploration, development and acquisition plans.
Led by a proven team of mine-builders and capital markets professionals, Honey Badger Silver is building a cash-generating, asset-backed platform for the bull cycle in precious and critical minerals.
